title: Vault Door Bubble Escape
description: A wooden bunker porch at dusk features a large open metallic vault door emitting light. A red-haired man in yellow pants shines a flashlight inside while a donkey in overalls and a robot stand nearby. Pink bubbles float everywhere, with string lights overhead and apocalyptic posters on the wall.
prompt: A wooden porch attached to a concrete bunker at twilight, with a massive circular metallic vault door swung open and emitting bright light from within. A red-haired man in a blue shirt and yellow pants stands on the steps holding a flashlight, next to a donkey wearing overalls and a bandana. A retro robot stands to the right. The structure has string lights along the roof, surrounded by dozens of large floating pink and teal translucent bubbles. Apocalyptic posters and warning signs are on the wall, including one that says THE END IS BUBBLING. A white dove flies nearby, with scattered debris and a skull-patterned rug on the ground.
